info.title: Kodi JSON-RPC API
info.description: Kodi's JSON-RPC 2.0 API. All methods are served from a single endpoint over HTTP POST and over WebSocket/TCP. Server-initiated notifications are only delivered over WebSocket/TCP and are documented separately in asyncapi.json.

methods.name: Player.Open

anyOf.description: Path to a smartplaylist (*.xsp) file

methods.name: AudioLibrary.SetInfoProvider
methods.summary: Assigns an information provider (scraper) to one artist or album, to every artist or album a musicdb:// view lists, or as the default, as the 'Set information provider' dialog does. Music binds a scraper to library items, not to source paths

params.name: applyto
params.description: "item" binds one artist or album named by artistid or albumid. "view" binds every artist or album listed by path. "default" makes the scraper the default for content and clears every item's own binding so that the default applies everywhere

params.name: scraperid
params.description: Addon id of the scraper, of the kind the target needs: an artists scraper for artists, an albums scraper for albums. Empty for "item" or "view" clears the binding so that the default applies; required for "default"

params.name: scrapersettings
params.description: Scraper settings as XML. Scraper defaults are used when empty

params.name: artistid
params.description: The artist, for "item". Exactly one of artistid and albumid

params.name: albumid
params.description: The album, for "item". Exactly one of artistid and albumid

params.name: path
params.description: A musicdb://artists/ or musicdb://albums/ path, for "view". Its filter options select the items; an artistid or albumid option and the item in the path are ignored, since the view is the listing. An albums path leaves singles out unless it carries show_singles=true

params.name: content
params.description: Which default to set, for "default": "artists" or "albums"

params.name: refresh
params.description: Refresh the additional information of the items bound, with the scraper now in force

methods.name: GUI.TakeScreenshot
methods.summary: Takes a screenshot into the configured screenshot folder and answers with the files it wrote. Waits for the capture to be encoded, so every file it names is complete when the response arrives. Pass a returned path to Files.PrepareDownload to fetch the image. Answers Unavailable when no screenshot folder is configured.

params.name: content
params.description: composite captures the full display output, video only the video frame, both writes two files, the video frame and the full composite, from the same rendered frame

params.name: target
params.description: A plain .png file name, written to the configured folder, overwriting an existing file of that name. Names the composite; the video frame takes the matching "-video" name. Auto-numbered as screenshotNNNNN.png when omitted; the auto-numbered name runs out at 65535.

composite.description: Path of the full display output, under special://screenshots. Absent when only the video frame was captured.

video.description: Path of the video frame alone, under special://screenshots. Absent when only the composite was captured.

methods.name: GUI.DeleteScreenshots
methods.summary: Deletes screenshots from the configured screenshot folder. Disabled unless <jsonrpc><allowscreenshotdeletion>true</allowscreenshotdeletion></jsonrpc> is set in advancedsettings.xml; answers Unavailable while it is off.

params.name: file
params.description: The one screenshot to delete, named as GUI.TakeScreenshot answered or as a plain file name. Every .png in the folder is deleted when omitted. Nothing outside the folder is reachable.

thumbnail.description: Image URL for this broadcast's own artwork, servable by the web server's /image/ endpoint. Empty when the broadcast has no image.

recordingid.description: Identifies the recording of this broadcast for PVR.GetRecordingDetails. -1 when the broadcast has no recording.

thumbnail.description: Image URL for the channel's own logo, servable by the web server's /image/ endpoint. This is the channel's logo, never the currently airing broadcast's artwork - for that, read thumbnail from broadcastnow.

channeluid.description: The channel's own identifier on the client that provides it. A broadcast and a recording report the same value as channeluid. Unrelated to uniqueid on a library item, which is a set of scraper identifiers.

icon.description: Image URL for the channel's own logo, servable by the web server's /image/ endpoint.

iconpath.description: Image URL for the provider's own icon, servable by the web server's /image/ endpoint.

countries.description: ISO 3166 country codes this provider serves.

languages.description: RFC 5646 language codes this provider broadcasts in.

title.description: Title of the recorded item itself. For a recorded episode this is the episode's own name and showtitle carries the show; for anything else it is the programme title and showtitle is empty.

icon.description: Image URL for the recording's own icon, servable by the web server's /image/ endpoint.

episodepart.description: Part number of a multi-part episode. Zero when the episode is not in parts.

showtitle.description: Title of the show this recording is an episode of. Empty when the recording is not of an episode.

titleextrainfo.description: Additional information the client supplies alongside the title, such as a sub title or a programme classification. Empty when the client supplies none.

lasthashcheck.description: Last time source was checked for changes

lastlibrarycheck.description: Last time texture existence was verified in library

stationname.description: Name of the radio station an internet stream is served by

mediapath.description: Media source path that identifies the item

dynpath.description: An experimental property for debug purposes, often same as mediapath but when different gives the actual file playing that should also be in file property

size.description: Size of the file in bytes

ready.description: True once the interface has finished starting and a skin is loaded with its first window active. False while Kodi is still starting and while a skin is reloading. A client that polls can wait on this rather than on the web server answering, which only proves the JSON-RPC service is up.

name.description: the component's own name, stable across languages and versions

enabled.description: whether the component's extra logging is in force

components.description: every log component this build knows, and whether each is enabled

sorttokens.description: Articles ignored during sorting when ignorearticle is enabled.
